data.content_ref: inline:Anchor attack-edge construction in cases: maintain a library of committed runs whose warrant-to-attack materializations are canonical, and calibrate the edge-construction rules (the `build_att` union) per case family so that the same warrant types yield the same attack patterns as the anchors. The label function stays pure and the fixpoint math is unchanged; what is strengthened is the quality of the attack graph itself — which is where the real work lives — making committed-root validity consistent with historical precedent rather than a per-run accident.
